name: UI not interactable / scroll issue
messageRegex: .*(ElementNotInteractableException|could not be scrolled into view|element not interactable).*
traceRegex: .*(ElementNotInteractableException|could not be scrolled into view|element not interactable).*

name: UI click blocked / overlay
messageRegex: .*(ElementClickInterceptedException|Other element would receive the click|click intercepted).*
traceRegex: .*(ElementClickInterceptedException|Other element would receive the click|click intercepted).*

name: Element not found / locator
messageRegex: .*(NoSuchElementException|Element with locator .* not found|Unable to locate element).*
traceRegex: .*(NoSuchElementException|Element with locator .* not found|Unable to locate element).*

name: Assertion / expected result mismatch
messageRegex: .*(AssertionError|should have been|should be|does not contain|did not match|!=|Expected).*
traceRegex: .*(AssertionError|should have been|should be|does not contain|did not match|!=|Expected).*

name: Robot keyword missing / syntax
messageRegex: .*(No keyword with name .* found|Keyword .* expected .* arguments|Several failures occurred|Variable .* not found).*
traceRegex: .*(No keyword with name .* found|Keyword .* expected .* arguments|Several failures occurred|Variable .* not found).*

name: Browser / driver crash
messageRegex: .*(WebDriverException|SessionNotCreatedException|invalid session id|Failed to decode response from marionette|Reached error page).*
traceRegex: .*(WebDriverException|SessionNotCreatedException|invalid session id|Failed to decode response from marionette|Reached error page).*
